title: Create a message for the consenting app connection owner
description: Exact method/args projection of Bindle RPC. Requires explicit resource/method consent, a live owner app connection, and exact token-bound browser Origin. App provenance is provider admission evidence, not publisher code attestation.

transactionId.description: Equal to RPC tx; preserve with createdAt on retry.

createdAt.description: Immutable operation creation milliseconds. Accepted only within the previous 24 hours plus at most 60 seconds future skew.

tags.description: Caller tags; app-message is reserved and added automatically. Original delivery tags are rule input.

args.description: Subject/body must contain non-whitespace text and exclude unsafe control characters. Tags exclude control characters and whitespace-only strings. Entire encoded JSON args is at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes. HTML forms/links are normal content; no separate actions field.

createOwn.permission: Explicit createOwn resource grant and Messages permission for this owner/client/connection generation; actual exact browser Origin must match token client. No contact capability or caller-selected recipient/sender.
